verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v1: wadaʿ ʿanka ʾaṭlālā biburqahi thahmadi likhawlata maʿ tawṣāfihā bikaʾithmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v2: wamā qawlu laylā war-rabābi wafartanā wamā qawlu hindi balha salmā wamahdadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v3: wadaʿ dhikra ʾayyāmi ṣ-ṣibā walayālihā wadaʿ ʿanka tadhkāra l-maghānī lighurradi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v4: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu sayyidī ladā rawḍihi wal-khaṭbu ʾashghala ʿan dadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v5: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu jihbidhī ḥabībi khalīli l-kulli barri wamurshidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v6: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu muhtadi kanajmi d-dujā bal badrihā l-mutawaqqidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v7: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu muqtafā bihi sunnata l-hādi n-nabiyyī muḥammadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v8: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu wad-di raʾūfu raḥīmi kāshifi l-ghammi munjidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v9: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu wārithi ʾabī l-fayḍi quṭbi l-ʾawliyā bna maḥammadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v10: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu muslaki ṭarīqa kirāmi l-qawmi ṣāfi muzahidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v11: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu wāsili ʾilā rabbihi nadbi ʾimāmi musaddadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v12: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu nāsiki taqiyyi naqiyyi khāzini l-jūdi muzbidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v13: walakin tafakkar kayfa ḍijʿahu mun maḍā ʾilā raḥmahi l-mawlā l-wafī l-mutaghghamidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v14: laqad nāma dhū ʿirḍi karīmi muhadhdhabi ʾabiyyu ʿani l-ʾadnāsi ṭahāru maḥtadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v15: damu khāliṣu lā yaqbalu l-ḥamla dharrata mina ḍ-ḍaymi ʿawnu lil-ʾaḥibbā waḥussadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v16: walaw ʾannahu shakhṣu yanāmu birūḥihi walakin biʾarwāḥi l-qulūbi min ʾaʿbudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v17: fayā ʿajabā min ʾaḥsani d-durri ḥuztahu ḍarīḥa ʾabī l-manṣūri mighyāthu mukmidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v18: tughghayibuhu ʿannā wafīnā tafajjaʿu tarā ṣadafā fīhi yatīmu zabarjadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v19: wamin ʿajabi taghsīluhu l-kullu ghullaha wafī ṣadrihi milbaḥri ʾaʿẓamu muzbidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v20: wamin ʿajabi ḥamlu l-ʾakhillā binaʿshihi wamaḥmūluhu ṣabrā wizānu bijalmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v21: wamin ʿajabi yaḥwīhi qabru waṣadruhu bitāsīʿi ʾarḍi was-samāʾi l-musammadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v22: waman ʿajabi taʿyīnuka l-ḥibba ʿindahu bakhīḍā bimā yaḥwīhi min ḥusni suʾudadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v23: juhūduka yā ʿayna l-ʿumā minhu ʾafḍalu fajūdī bdhulī damʿā damā watajarridi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v24: lifaqdi ʿimādi d-dīni shamsu furūḍihi wamiṣbāḥu mandūbātihi wal-mujarradi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v25: bakathu s-samā wal-ʾarḍa fuḥḥuqa bukāhumā ʿalā mithlihi ʾan yalqa mithlu wayūjadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v26: bakā kullu jinsi faqdahu wayazūruhu qabāʾilu shattā wuffadu baʿda wuffadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v27: waliyyu manāru d-dīni ʾaʿlāhu rifʿahu ʾanāratuhu ʿammat ʿumūma muḥammadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v28: ʿalayhi salāmu ṭāba yurḍīhi dāʾimā wāʾāli lahu waṣ-ṣaḥbi maʿ kulli muqtadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v29: ʿudūlu ʿani l-ʾarkhāṣi lam yulfa rākibā jawāzā walā taʾawīla lā bal biʾawkadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v30: walā ʿayba fīhi ghayra maḥṭāṭa ʾidh ḍujā ṭawāmu shukūri fī ʿumūri taʿʿabudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v31: ʿaliyyu jamīlu dh-dhikri ḥāza manāqibā ḥawat nayla ʾiʿjāzi wataʿdādi ʿuddadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v32: waliyyū rafīʿu ṣ-ṣīti sharfā wamaghribā fakam ligharībi minhu khayra tazawwudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v33: ʾabā jāhuhu ʿan kulli rāji biṭaharati ʾigh tirābā waḍaymā fī gharībi waʾabʿadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v34: ṣafiyyu naṣūḥu fāqa ʿilmā wasuʾudadā wamā ʿābahu ghayru llaʾīmi l-muʿarbidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v35: waliyyu shahīru kāmilu mutaʿāmilu wamarmāhu marma sayyidi l-qawmi ʾaḥmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v36: judhaylu jazīlu dhū maqāmi maraffaʿi farīdu ṭawīlu l-bāʿi war-rijli wal-yadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v37: sulaymānu ʾamri mūsawiyyu binajdati khalīliyyū dīni sunniyu limuḥammadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v38: falam yura yahtammu l-karāmāti qāʾila wamā hiyā ʾillā sukkaru fākhdhi turshadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v39: wafī marrati ʾukhrā liman rāma naylahā ʾalā hiyā ḥayḍu lir-rijāli bihā mdudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v40: manūʿu ʿani l-ʾijhādi bil-kashfi qāʾilā famushtariku l-ʿuffāri wal-mutaʿʿabidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v41: yarā ghayra ʾifrādi l-ʾilahi limaqṣadi ḥijābu kakummāli l-fuḥūli waz-zuhadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v42: ʾidhā jtamaʿa l-ʾashyākhu fahwa khaṭībuhum biwaʿẓi balīghi min faṣāḥati muzwidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v43: ʾalā ʾinnahu shaykhu l-mashāyikhi kullihim fakam ʿaylami minhu ḥtawā min tamaddudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v44: ʾidhā naḥnu jiʾinā naḥwahu min taʿʿalami wajadnāhu sahlā layyinā lam yushaddidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v45: matā jāʾa qawmu ʿaḍḍahum qaḥṭu maḥallihim ʾatāhum bighaythi hāṭilu l-jūdi min ghadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v46: ʿalā nafsihi kam ʾakthara ḍ-ḍura wal-ʾadhā linafʿi l-barāyā wal-ʾilahi bimarṣadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v47: hadā ʾanfusā ḍallat ʿani r-rushdi fāhtadat faṣāmat waqāmat laylahā bitahhajudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v48: ʾatā wabaqāʾa s-sūdi ẓulmu waẓulmahu faqāma bisayfi l-hammi bil-ḥazmi mujradi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v49: fajāhada fīhā bis-sayāsati wan-nadā waʿilmi waḥilmi fāhtadā kullu muʿtadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v50: faṣārat zawāyāhu fī qurāhā jamīʿihā milāʾu bifawji rākiʿīna wasujjadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v51: liʾaṣwātihim fī kulli yawmi walaylati dawiyyu ladā kulli z-zawāyā wamasjidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v52: jazāhu ʿani l-ʾikhwāni rabbiyā khayra mā jazā kulla shaykhi bīḥtirāmi muʾabbadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v53: fallāhi badru ṭāliʿu naḥwa gharbinā waʾishrāqu layli l-juhdi sharqiyā maqṣadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v54: wayuḥrimu bil-mīqāti nāwī ḥajjahi waliyyu limawlā ʾafraḍa l-ḥajja ʾawḥadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v55: wajāʾa waṭāfa l-bayta mawlāhu murqiyā wazāra waʾathnā khayra rusli muḥammadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v56: waʿāda ʾilaynā bībtihāji lisunnati munīrā lanā mā llāhu yurḍī linahtadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v57: fanāla mina l-khallāqi mā nāla waḥdahu waʿan sāʾiri l-ḥujjāji ṣāra bimufradi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v58: wamā fāʿilu bil-ḥajji yamtāzu lil-fatā siwā māliki fākhtaṣṣa mā khtaṣṣa min yadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v59: laqad bazaghat shamsu l-ʾinārati janbahu ʿalā qaṭrinā ḥattā htadā kulli muʿtadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v60: tazalzalati d-dunyā biʾan kāna ghuyyimat faṣārat qulūbu l-mustanīrīna fī l-ghadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v61: walaw kānati l-ʾājālu fīhā sawiyyata ʾawi l-ʾajalu l-ʾaqṣā linafsika naḥmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v62: wāʾāhi falaw ʾanna l-fidā laka muqbilu lirūḥika bil-ʾarwāḥi yā r-rūḥu naftadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v63: walakin qaḍā l-qāḍī ʾufūlaka dūnanā fanaḥmaduhu tarḍāhu min mutaʿʿamadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v64: faṣārat tiwāwūnu taḥūzu mafākhirā bimaʾamali saʿdi fī l-ḥawāʾiji musʿidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v65: ʾalā kushifat shamsu s-samā ʿāma shamsinā kamā kashafat waylī bihi taḥta mulḥidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v66: wafī dhāka takhyīlu ʿalā ʿawna ʾukhtihā bakathā waʾahlu l-ʿulwi was-sufli fāqtadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v67: ʾalā yawmuhu yawmu th-thalāthā biẓuhrihi laqad bāqa ḥarru sh-shamsi naḥwa t-tabarrudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v68: bidhī l-qiʿdati l-mubdāti yā rabbi ṣalliyan ʿalā khillihi khayri l-mushaffaʿi fī l-ghadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v69: waghulliqati l-ʾabwābu dūna tijārati waqad ʾurjifa l-ʾaqwāmu min ghaybi sayyidī
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v70: waʾudhishati l-ʾabwābu kādat taṣaddaʿat ṣudūra ʾahālīhā bikulli tanahudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v71: yukhayyilunī yawma n-nabiyyī ʾimāminā ʿalā ghummahi fī ḥayrati watawaqqudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v72: faghghaṣat fijāja l-ʾarḍi lam tara furjaha taqūlu ʾalā ʿindī sabīlu liwurradi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v73: fakānati ttiṣālu dh-dhākirīna ttiṣālahum bukāʾa ladā kulli ṭ-ṭarīqi wamaqṣadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v74: fawā ʾasafī ʿāma nqirāḍi ghaṭārifi watafqāri ʾaḥbābi waghurri wasandadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v75: lahu ʾikhwatu ṭīnā wadīnā tasallafat lidāri l-baqāʾi wal-kullu fāqa bisuʾudadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v76: saʿīdāni maḥmūdu waʿamri wamaḥmadā ni fāṭimahu bintu lahu fī t-tawaddudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v77: likullihim ḥaẓẓu min ʾasmāʾi kullihim fī l-ʾayyāmi wal-ʾafʿāli wal-faṭmi ʿan dadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v78: kadhalika ḥujjāju l-jaḥājiḥi qādata fabadru wabadru thumma badru limuqtadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v79: humu l-murtaḍā ʿabdu l-ʾilahi washaykhu kan manāziluhum taʿlū manāzila farqadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v80: wakulluhum ʾillā saʿīdu bnu ʾaḥmadi fafī ʿammihi hadhā wahwa fī shasaldadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v81: ʿalā kullihim min rabbihim saḥbu raḥmahi tahāṭala fī ʾarwāḥihim kullu musnadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v82: layabkī bna ʿuthmāni ḥuḍūrā waghayyata naqiyyu lahu bal- ʿalā dīni ʾaḥmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v83: ʿalayhim maʿa l-ʾazwāji wal-ʾāli kullihim ṣalātu wataslīmu madāma tajaddudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v84: layabkī ʾimāma l-ʾaskhiyāʾi wafakhrahum ḍughāma ʾiyāsī thumma ʾaytāma ʿummadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v85: huwa l-badalu l-marḍiyyū min kulli wad-di wazawji wamizri niʿma shaykhī mukhalladi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v86: labaykī ʾimāma l-ʾawliyāʾ ʾamīnahum khalīfata quṭbi barzakhi khatmi ʾaḥmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v87: waʿanhu waʿan hadhā l-khalīfati dāʾimā riḍā rabbinā maʿ raḥmahi watahhajudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v88: labaykī ʾamīra l-muʾuminīna kafīlahum ḥamāhumu ladā kulli l-ʾadhā wat-tahhadudi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v89: waman dhā yasuddu l-khizyā wal-fakhra wal-bilā muzaḥziḥu ʾadnāsi r-radhāʾili yunjidi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v90: waman lī birifqi l-khaṭbi ʾidh jāʾa fajʾaha yudhakkiru hadhā khaṭbuhu kulla mashhadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v91: waman lī biʾikhrāji l-ḥaqāʾiqi nāṣiḥā waman lī bitadrīsi l-kitābi wamusnadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v92: waman lī biwrshi bal junaydi wal-ashʿarī waman lī bīʾādābi waḍarbi l-muʿaddadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v93: waman lī bibadhli l-fiqhi wan-naḥwa minṭiqi bayāni maʿānīhā badīʿi bimasʿadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v94: waman lī binajmi fī n-nujūmi wamūṣili ʾaṣūlā ʿarūḍā siyarata l-badri miqwadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v95: waman lī bibaḥri yustaghāthu biwardihi waʾamwājuhu yurwā bihā ghulalu s-sadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v96: waman lī biʾastādhi yurabbī murīdahu bilā khalwati bal himmahi mithla ʾaḥmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v97: waman lī bitaʾalīfi yudhakkiru man maḍā qadīmā ʿalā nahji r-rasūli musaddadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v98: falā hāba ʾiqbālu ʿalā dhikri faḍlihi lidhā khtartu khatmā bīttiḍāʾi bimashhadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v99: wanasʾalu rabbi llāha taʿmīra naslihi bijāhi n-nabī fī ʾaṭyabi l-ʿayshi ʾarghadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v100: likullihim yasrī l-ʿulā wasiyāsata waʾabdala min naḥsi l-balā khayra l-ʾasʿadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v101: watarjū mina r-raḥmāni tanẓīma shamlihi bizumrati khayri l-ʿālamīna ʾaḥmadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v102: ʿalayhi bilā ḥaddi maʿa l-ʾāli ṣaḥbihi ṣalātu wataslīmu yaqūmu kaʾarnadi
verses.wada-anka-atlalan-c1-v103: wal-azwāji wadh-dhuriyyati d-dahra sarmadā kadhā tābiʿūna tābiʿūna wamuqtadi
